name: Chicken Wings
siboNotes: Plain chicken wings are excellent for SIBO as they're protein-rich and naturally FODMAP-free. Avoid marinades or sauces containing garlic, onion, or high FODMAP ingredients.
preparationTips: Season with SIBO-safe herbs like oregano, thyme, and rosemary
Use garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic for flavor
Avoid pre-made marinades which often contain onion and garlic powders
Bake, grill, or air-fry for crispy texture without breading
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in B vitamins, especially niacin and B6
Good source of selenium and phosphorus
